title: Google updates Project Genie, its interactive world builder, with Street View integration, and expands access to the tool to AI Ultra subscribers globally (Jessica Conditt/Engadget)
summary: Jessica Conditt / Engadget: Google updates Project Genie, its interactive world builder, with Street View integration, and expands access to the tool to AI Ultra subscribers globally — Ground your snow-globe worlds in real-world locations from Google Maps. — Project Genie is rolling out today …
